dashboard.description: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct / vLLM 0.8.0 V0. 5s scrape; rolling 1m rate and histogram estimates. Use annotations and absolute UTC ranges to correlate cases. No artificial zero fill.

panels.description: Engine time to first token; p50/p95 are histogram interpolation estimates over a rolling 1 minute. Includes engine queuing; distinct from client first-content latency. Zero observations produce NaN / no data.
panels.title: TTFT — histogram estimates

panels.description: Generated tokens per second, averaged over a rolling 1 minute; not instantaneous decode speed.
panels.title: Generation throughput

panels.description: Gauges sampled every 5 seconds. Short requests and transient queues can occur between samples.
panels.title: Running / waiting requests

panels.description: Rolling 1 minute. Mean uses sum/count. V0 first bucket is 0.3s: if all observations are below it, interpolated p50=0.15s and p95=0.285s are NOT measured queue times. Zero observations stay NaN / no data.
panels.title: Queue time — mean and histogram estimates

panels.description: Percentage of allocated GPU KV cache blocks in use, not physical GPU memory utilization. Host nvidia-smi CSV measures physical memory separately. Five-second scrape can miss short peaks.
panels.title: GPU KV cache usage

panels.description: Engine request completion latency; p50/p95 are histogram interpolation estimates over a rolling 1 minute. Not client HTTP latency. Zero observations produce NaN / no data.
panels.title: End-to-end latency — histogram estimates
